props.headline: Baked fresh in Raglan every morning.
props.description: A local, independent bakery dedicated to traditional long-fermentation sourdough, flaky pastries, and great organic coffee.

items.title: Artisan sourdough
items.description: Naturally leavened loaves baked daily using organic New Zealand flour.

items.title: Daily pastries
items.description: Flaky croissants, sweet tarts, and seasonal brioche made fresh in-house.

items.title: Hot filter & espresso
items.description: Expertly brewed coffee using beans sourced from local boutique roasters.

props.title: Made with care, served with love.
props.body: We started Aroha Bakery with a simple goal: to bring the joy of real, slow-fermented bread to our Raglan community. Every loaf is shaped by hand and baked with patience using locally sourced ingredients.

items.quote: The best sourdough in the country, hands down. Get in early before the almond croissants sell out!
items.author: Liam Wright

items.quote: A beautiful, warm atmosphere and the friendliest staff. It has become our daily morning ritual.
items.author: Emma Davis
